title: Persona detail reads every strategy spec to count one persona on hosted

summary.root_cause: In services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py (_routed_strategies_for_persona, line 2514), the bounded count branch (_routed_strategy_counts_by_persona -> store.count_strategy_persona_bindings) was gated by `bool(getattr(rks, '_has_injected_strategy_specs', False)) and not (os.getenv('PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL') or os.getenv('PANTHEON_REGISTRY_URL'))`. When PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL was set (as on hosted), _routed_strategies_for_persona fell back to store.list_strategy_specs(persona_id=clean_id), which fetched and normalized all 3,376 canonical strategy specs from /api/registry/strategy-specs and filtered persona_id in Python.
fix: Removed the unit-test-only `_has_injected_strategy_specs` and `not (PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL or PANTHEON_REGISTRY_URL)` guards in `services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py:_routed_strategies_for_persona` so that whenever ReadSurfacePorts is active (and list_strategy_specs / _fetch_canonical_strategy_specs are not monkeypatched on the instance), `_routed_strategies_for_persona` delegates to `_routed_strategy_counts_by_persona()`, which calls `store.count_strategy_persona_bindings()` (`GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=persona_binding_counts` on the registry URL path).
Decorated `PersonaService.patch_persona` with `@request_read_scope()` so its two calls to `_routed_strategies_for_persona(persona_id)` share one request-scoped `persona_routed_strategy_counts` read.

Aligned `list_strategy_specs`, `_list_strategy_specs_uncached`, and `count_strategy_persona_bindings` in `services/control-plane/bff/ports/research_knowledge_source.py` on persona ID whitespace stripping and metadata fallback extraction (`personaIds`, `persona_ids`, `persona_id`, and `artifact_state` / `metadata.lifecycle_state` / `metadata.state` / `metadata.status`).

ac1_bounded_registry_persona_binding_cou.requirement: With PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL set as on hosted, the routed strategy count for one persona uses the bounded registry persona_binding_counts read and never calls the full strategy spec read, and a test proves it by failing on any full spec fetch

ac2_all_callers_match_full_read_across_r.requirement: Every caller of _routed_strategies_for_persona gets the same count as the full read for the real spec shapes including retired, multi-version, fixture pack, and personas with zero strategies, and a test compares both reads on the same specs

ac3_registry_count_failure_status_and_er.requirement: Registry count read failures keep the same status and error the detail routes return today

verified_failure_cases.failure: invalid count payload ([], negative, bool, str)

ac4_bff_cpu_reduction_on_same_machine.requirement: BFF CPU for one GET /bff/personas/{id} with the registry URL path drops by at least 70 percent and evidence records before and after numbers measured on the same machine

ac5_no_test_weakened_or_deleted.requirement: No existing test is weakened or deleted to pass and any changed assertion is justified in evidence
